concepts.name: visuospatialKnowledge
concepts.description: Reasoning with visuospatial knowledge that combines visual information (what) and spatial information (where).

concepts.name: propositionalRepresentation
concepts.description: Symbolic representation with entities and relations expressed as propositions.

concepts.name: analogicalRepresentation
concepts.description: Structural representation maintaining spatial or relational correspondence between domains.

concepts.name: system
concepts.description: Set of components forming a functional whole.

concepts.name: structure
concepts.description: Model representing physical components and visible interconnections of a system.

concepts.name: behavior
concepts.description: Model of internal processes or state transitions in a system.

concepts.name: function
concepts.description: Model describing intended outcomes or purposes of a system.

concepts.name: designProblem
concepts.description: Ill-defined and open-ended problem where both problem and solution co-evolve.

concepts.name: creativeProduct
concepts.description: Result that is novel, non-obvious, and desirable.

assertions.name: goodAdvancedAnalysis
assertions.description: The analysis correctly integrates visuospatial reasoning, systems thinking, design thinking, and creativity.
assertions.property: finalConfiguration contains validated visuospatial, systems, design and creativity analyses
